title: CarrierInvoiceSubmission
description: A Carrier invoice as the Carrier invoice Logic App hands it to the ERP billing API (Canonical Model document, version 1): the Carrier's own invoice number and date and one line per Carrier booking it claims. The carrierId is the Carrier API Management took from the token (ADR 0005); what the Carrier wrote never sets it. Amounts are in EUR without VAT.

carrierId.description: The Carrier, from the caller's token.

invoiceNumber.description: The Carrier's own invoice number. Unique per Carrier.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID API Management created for the Carrier invoice.

lines.description: One line per Carrier booking, with no Carrier booking reference twice. The ERP refuses an invoice without lines, a line without a reference and a line with an amount of zero or less, each with a stable code.

carrierBookingReference.description: The Carrier's own reference for the booking, as the Carrier cost has it.

amount.description: What the Carrier claims for the booking, without VAT.
